reviews.review_title: Pedel Rebel, Cardio just got fun!!!
reviews.review_description: This game will get your heart racing for sure. I have never played a game that makes me want to exercise, except this one!  The graphics and colours are vibrant, it is well thought out and fun, the fact that the faster you pedel, the faster you go is translated fantastically into this world.  ToasterFaceGames, you have done an amazing job on this
I love this game so far. It’s a lot of fun, and it makes time on the exercise bike fly by. I recommend using it with a cadence sensor on the bike, which you can buy for around $16 online.

reviews.review_title: Fun game and great for exercise!
reviews.review_description:
Interesting idea for an exercise game to use the controllers or sensors for pedals and it works great.
I like the aesthetics and vibe too. Im only playing with the controllers at the minute but ill ill definitely be playing more when im on the exercise bike next.
Loving it so far and excited to see how it evolves during early access!

reviews.review_title: Get your cardio in a cool synth world
reviews.review_description: Such a clever idea and a great way to make exercise a bit more fun. Love the visuals and the overall feel of the game. It's surprisingly easy to get caught up in playing and forget you're actually exercising. Im a huge advocate for using VR to work up a sweat. Looking forward to seeing what they add next!
